reviews.question: Is the 530 nm specification a calibration period or a wavelength?
reviews.answer:
530 nm is the wavelength of the green light the Alba sensor uses to measure turbidity. [fixture 08, p. 1](nodus://review-source/review-49d9b19cdc36edc0e8c191ee/1)

The same excerpt separately says calibration is required every 30 days. [fixture 08, p. 1](nodus://review-source/review-49d9b19cdc36edc0e8c191ee/1)

Alba - archive 8 The Alba sensor uses green light at 530 nm to measure turbidity. It does not measure oxygen concentration. Calibration is required every 30 days. *Source: Nodus QA synthetic archive.*
